name: codex-gamebook-engine
description: CLI emulator and tooling for playing Gamebook Format (GBF) JSON game files

comments.fengari_pin_rationale: Lua 5.3 runtime (fengari). Pinned to a specific version rather than a floating ^0.1.5 because upstream Fengari does not actively cut releases — the npm 0.1.5 build has been stable for years and we've validated all our combat round scripts and section script events against it. If upstream ever ships a newer release that we want to adopt, bump this pin deliberately and re-run the full regression harness (lw_probe, warlock_probe, lw_run1..4, warlock_run1..3, wwy_run1..2) to verify nothing regressed. The browser side uses the same Lua runtime: fengari-web.js is committed as a static webpack build and reports Fengari 0.1.5 (FENGARI_VERSION_MAJOR/MINOR/RELEASE = 0/1/5) — the same version as this npm pin, so the Node and browser sandboxes are identical. cli-emulator/script-runtime.js is the single shared sandbox consumed by play.js (Node), validate-book.js (Node), and dist/verify-book.bundle.js (browser, via fengari-web.js).
comments.why_not_wasmoon: wasmoon (Lua 5.4 via WASM) is a stronger maintained alternative. We evaluated it and decided the port cost is not justified right now — all existing Lua scripts are simple enough that Fengari 0.1.5 runs them correctly and no maintenance bugs have surfaced in practice. Tracked as a back-burner option.
